candidates.text: ! scope="row" | | 1858–1861 | Flag of the Kingdom of Samoa | A red field with a white crescent and a five-pointed star.
! scope="row" | | 1872–1873 | Flag of the Kingdom of Samoa | A nine-striped field (five blue stripes and four white stripes) and a red canton with two crescent moons and four five-pointed stars.
! scope="row" | | 1873–1875 | Flag of the Kingdom of Samoa | A red field with a white five-pointed star on the blue canton.

! scope="row" | | 1875–1879 | Flag of the Kingdom of Samoa | A seven-striped field (four red stripes and three white stripes) and a five-pointed star on the blue canton, similar to the flag of Liberia.
